newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Arris started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Arris started as buy.

text.p: --Vector Securities analyst Michael King said he started coverage of Arris Pharmaceutical Corp with a buy rating.
--Shares in the developer of protease inhibitors for treatment of various diseases were up 3/8 to 13-1/2.

--"Arris is a leader in the field of the integrated, multi-disciplinary discovery and development of protease inhibitors for a wide variety of under-addressed conditions such as asthma, cancer and infectious diseases," King said.
